outcome_class_rationale: Fitch downgraded Erlanger BBB+ -> BBB in October 2018 citing years of declining operating performance. Moody's followed by revising outlook from positive to stable. Erlanger reported FY19 net loss of $4.4M, validating downgrade rationale.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: FY16 revenue $803M, operating margin 2.8%, DCOH 98.8 — all from Times Free Press / Fitch Nov 2016 release directly.

_research_notes: Erlanger is Chattanooga's safety-net academic medical center (UT-affiliated). Heavy physician employment growth (140 to 380 docs 2014-2018) contributed to operating losses. No M&A in window — focus was internal expense restructuring. Prepared for nonprofit conversion later.
